entries.title: Getting started
entries.summary: Your quick reference for races, skills and equipment.

sections.title: Open the guide
lines: Press F8 in the world, or use Guide on the Tensura status screen or the guide button in the pause menu. The key can be changed in Controls.

sections.title: Find what you need
lines: Search by name, ability, damage type or requirement. Categories narrow the results. Scroll each panel independently; use the arrows to return to earlier pages. Ctrl+F focuses search.

sections.title: Read the numbers
lines: Values are defaults. Server settings, mastery and other bonuses can change them. Skill pages list the damage type; support moves do not deal damage.

entries.title: Heavenly Restriction lineage
entries.summary: Choose Fettered Human at reincarnation. Difficulty: Hard. The lineage keeps your human appearance.

sections.title: Starting resources
lines: 1,500–2,000 aura and 50–100 magicules. Chained is granted at birth and retained through evolution; starting aura is not multiplied.

sections.title: Evolution requirements
lines: Tempered Vessel: 100,000 total EP; 1 mastered Battlewills; Chained 20%.
Unshackled: 500,000 total EP; 2 mastered Battlewills; Chained 40%.
Heavenly Restricted: 2,000,000 total EP; 3 mastered Battlewills; Chained 60%.
Heavenbreaker: 8,000,000 total EP; 4 mastered Battlewills; Chained 100%.

sections.title: Progression
lines: Use Tensura’s race evolution menu. EP requirements check the total shown in Status. Hunter’s Recovery is granted at Unshackled; Apex Renewal at Heavenly Restricted; Sovereign Rebirth at Heavenbreaker.

sections.title: Racial health bonuses
lines: Tempered Vessel: +100 HP / +400 SHP. Unshackled: +300 HP / +1,600 SHP.
Heavenly Restricted: +600 HP / +3,600 SHP. Heavenbreaker: +1,000 HP / +6,600 SHP. Each stage replaces the old racial bonuses.

sections.title: Starting skill rolls
lines: Skills with magicule-cost abilities or target-skill stealing/copying are excluded from Fettered Human’s starting rolls. Pride is exempt; Creator and recorded derived skills remain allowed.

entries.title: Chained
entries.summary: The lineage’s Unique Skill trades magical growth and unrestricted learning for aura and physical combat.

sections.title: Always active while owned
lines: Later maximum-aura gains receive 5× growth; existing magicule capacity is retained but cannot grow. EP gains split 90% aura / 10% magicules; the blocked magicule share is not redirected.
Retain up to 1 magicule per second and convert the remaining computed regeneration, including biome and sleep bonuses, into aura.

Learn Battlewills, resistances/nullifications, reincarnation skills and their derived skills, and lineage recovery skills. Blocked skills remain visible but cannot finish learning. Resistances use their configured acquisition cost in current aura.

sections.title: Toggle: Martial Supremacy
lines: Battlewill learning/mastery +9; resistance learning +19. Battlewill-sourced attacks deal 5× damage; other Physical hits deal 3×. These branches do not stack. Numeric Battlewill buffs receive 3× effectiveness; Aura Sword is excluded.

sections.title: Mastered: Broken Limit
lines: Always active when mastered. Your hits ignore dodge and lower Nullification to Resistance, and Resistance to nothing.

sections.title: In slot: Unerring Body
lines: 10% damage reduction, 100% projectile dodge and 25% other dodge, subject to native bypass rules. Immune to Fear, Slowness, Burden and Haki effects.

sections.title: Press: Severance Rush
lines: Aim and teleport up to 16 blocks, including in the air; stop before the aimed enemy. Physical damage along a 3-block radius and at the 4-block arrival. Cost: 2% current aura. Cooldown: 1 second.
Base damage: path 1.5 × √A + W; arrival 3 × √A + W. A is the base aura payment; W is the held weapon contribution. Weapon enchantments and engravings apply.

entries.title: Unbound
entries.summary: Chained automatically evolves into this Ultimate when you are Heavenbreaker, fully master Chained, and become a True Hero or True Demon Lord.

sections.title: Retained pact
lines: Retains Chained’s restrictions, aura growth and regeneration conversion. Presets and progress carry over.

sections.title: Improved combat
lines: Toggle: 8× Battlewill damage or 5× other Physical damage; 4× numeric Battlewill buffs except Aura Sword. The damage branches remain separate.
In slot: 30% damage reduction, 100% projectile dodge and 50% other dodge. Retains Fear, Slowness, Burden and Haki immunity.
Mastered Broken Limit retains resistance degradation and dodge bypass, and makes your attacks critical hits.

sections.title: Severance Rush
lines: The same 16-block aim teleport and Physical path/arrival formulas as Chained. Cost: 2% current aura. Cooldown: 1 second. Held weapon effects apply.

sections.title: Counter
lines: Press to hold a defensive stance for 3 seconds with movement speed 0. The first eligible enemy hit is negated and releases a terrain-piercing slash toward the attacker, hitting other enemies along its path.
Cost: 10% current aura on entry. Cooldown: 10 seconds. Press again to cancel early for free.
Physical base damage: 10 × negated damage + 6 × √A + W. The released weapon’s damage, enchantments and engravings apply; toggle bonuses and critical hits then apply.

entries.title: Schema
entries.summary: A Battlewill with a customizable six-effect tree. Learn: 1,000 points. Master: 2,000 points.

sections.title: Use
lines: Press Build to open the tree. Choose Add Mito, Add Str. or Add Regen; select a slot to move or remove it. Apply saves; Close discards unapplied edits. Toggle Schema to activate the saved tree.

sections.title: Effects per stack
lines: Mitochondrial: +500% aura regeneration; −5% outgoing damage.
Strength: +5 base attack damage; +2% damage taken.
Regenerative: +20% HP/SHP healing received; +5% aura and magicule costs. Healing bonuses apply once and respect native limits.

sections.title: Slot order and mastery
lines: Positive weights start at 100%, 50%, 25%, 12.5%, 6.25%, 3.125%. Every 400 mastery makes another slot full strength, reaching all six at 2,000. All effects share that order; drawbacks always stay full strength.
Chained/Unbound boosts positive Battlewill bonuses once; drawbacks are not boosted.

sections.title: Training
lines: Qualifying aura recovery, Strength hits and Regenerative healing share one mastery gain every 30 seconds. Idle full reserves, editing and toggling grant no training. The timer and build persist after saving.

entries.title: Air Walk
entries.summary: A Battlewill evolution of Air Float / Air Flight.

sections.title: Learn
lines: Master your permanent Air Float, then complete the new learning entry in the Battlewill menu.

sections.title: Use
lines: Press to enable free flight using aura. Press again to stop; stopping is free even with empty aura.
Cost: 30 aura to activate and 30 aura per second actually flying. Mastery halves both to 15. No magicule cost or cooldown.

entries.title: Instant Transmission
entries.summary: A Battlewill evolution of Instant Move for coordinate self-teleportation.

sections.title: Learn
lines: Master your permanent Instant Move, then complete its evolution’s learning entry.

sections.title: Use
lines: Press to enter X, Y and Z, then choose Warp. Only you travel, within the current dimension; it does not create portals.
Charge: 100 ticks / 5 seconds; instant at mastery. Cost: 10 aura per block of 3D distance, halved to 5 at mastery. Opening the menu is free.

sections.title: Limits
lines: Native spatial blocks still apply. Invalid or unfunded requests do not start a cast. Losing the skill, dying, logging out or changing dimension cancels a pending cast; a started cast has already paid.

entries.title: Aura recovery skills
entries.summary: Toggle a recovery skill to heal with aura. Only your strongest toggled tier works; full reserves cost nothing.

sections.title: Hunter’s Recovery
lines: Restore 4 HP per second, or 8 mastered, at 20 aura per base HP.

sections.title: Apex Renewal
lines: Restore missing HP every half second. Cost: 30 aura per base HP, or 20 mastered.

sections.title: Sovereign Rebirth
lines: Restore HP and SHP every half second. Cost: 30 aura per HP / 10 per SHP, or 20 / 5 mastered. Can prevent ordinary fatal damage while funded; native bypass and suppression rules still apply.

sections.title: Obtaining
lines: Granted by the relevant Heavenly Restriction evolutions. Earlier recovery skills remain available, but do not heal in parallel.

entries.title: Inverted Spear of Heaven
entries.summary: A rare weapon from ominous trial vault loot, with the same attack stats as a Hihiirokane Sword.

sections.title: Stats and obtaining
lines: 80 total ordinary player attack damage; 1.6 attack speed. Rare 2% additional ominous-vault reward. Regular vaults do not drop it.

sections.title: Nullification engraving
lines: Weapon hits instantly shatter barriers, remove skill status effects, and prevent skill activation for 2 seconds. The weapon can attack Spiritual Entities.
Held main-hand attacks, Severance Rush and Counter carry the engraving. Spiritual contact bypasses the spiritual-body Physical reduction, while armor, resistance, dodge and PvP rules still apply.

entries.title: Parallel World Jumper
entries.summary: Unique skill · Single-player travel through a hidden library of up to 128 worlds.

sections.title: World Jump · Active, Press
lines: With no destination selected, every dimension regenerates under a new seed. Your character, inventory and progression carry over. The game saves and reloads. Cooldown: 5 minutes, shared by fresh and return jumps. World Select remains usable during cooldown. No resource cost or damage.

sections.title: World Select · Active, Press · Requires Learning
lines: World Select must be learned separately. Select its mode and press the skill to gain learning points; once learned, pressing it opens the world menu.

Browse previously visited worlds. Search by name or seed, choose a world, then press Set next jump. World Jump travels there once, preserving its terrain, builds and entities while bringing your current character, inventory, skills and progression.
Choose New World and confirm to clear your selection. Selecting a destination does not teleport you. After a jump, the next unselected jump generates a fresh seed again.
Earlier World Hop saves are imported when their recorded previous saves still exist in this instance. Missing saves cannot be selected.

sections.title: Arrival
lines: Land on the nearest safe ground around your previous coordinates. If there is no nearby safe ground, World Hop searches around the Overworld spawn instead.

sections.title: Hidden world library
lines: Only the active save appears in Singleplayer. All visited worlds are stored inside its hidden library and reached through World Select. The limit is 128 worlds, including the active world. At the limit, revisit existing worlds; new-world creation is blocked.

Deleting the active save from Singleplayer deletes the entire hidden library, including its visited worlds and internal recovery copies. Renaming or backing up the whole save keeps the library with it.
Existing recorded travel history is moved into the library on the next jump. Unrelated saves remain separate. Older libraries above 128 retain their worlds but cannot create more.

sections.title: Obtaining
lines: Can roll as a reincarnation Unique in a private single-player world. Cannot be acquired, copied, learned or used on dedicated servers or while open to LAN. Chained must receive it through reincarnation to permit it.

entries.title: Fusion
entries.summary: Unique skill · Share a body and skills with a subordinate or consenting player for 3 minutes.

sections.title: Fuse · Active, Press
lines: Aim within 16 blocks at your subordinate or another player. Players must accept the invitation. You control a subordinate’s fused form; a receiving player controls their own fused body.

Fused EP = (your actual max EP + the target’s actual max EP) × 1.5. Aura and magicule capacities keep the participants’ combined resource split. Both resources regenerate 10× faster; final outgoing damage is doubled.

HP and SHP combine by addition: maximum HP/SHP and the remaining HP/SHP are each summed. The EP multiplier does not multiply HP or SHP. Native skill menus show the borrowed abilities in their normal categories; use f:temporary to find temporary entries.

The fused body temporarily has the participants’ skills. Existing learned skills are retained. Borrowed skills and their storage/cooldown state return to their owner after separation; normal acquisition and activation restrictions apply.
Duration: 3 minutes. Press Fuse again or choose Separate Fusion in the pause menu to end early. The absorbed caster can also sneak to separate. No resource cost or additional cooldown.

sections.title: Separation
lines: Both participants receive Paralysis II and Fragility II for 5 minutes, including after early separation. Their original EP, forms and permanent skills return.
Remaining resources are divided proportionally; fusing cannot refill either participant for free. Death, disconnect, dimension change or server shutdown ends Fusion. Fusion cannot be nested.

sections.title: Damage type
lines: Fuse has no direct attack damage. The ×2 multiplier retains each attack’s original damage type, including Physical, magical and direct Spiritual damage.

sections.title: Obtaining
lines: Available in normal Unique reincarnation rolls. Excluded from Fettered Human’s roll pool because it borrows target skills.

entries.title: Prospector
entries.summary: Mine faster, gain extra Fortune, sense ores and use native refining.

sections.title: Passive · Toggle
lines: Mining speed +50%. Fortune +3, added to the tool's existing level; Fortune III becomes effective Fortune VI. The tool is unchanged, and Silk Touch keeps its normal behavior.
Correctly mining stone or deepslate has a 1% chance to find one extra resource. Common resources are more likely than rare gems; magic ore shards can appear.

Sense loaded ore deposits through terrain within 32 blocks. Faint markers use distinct colors and glyphs. Look toward a marker for its ore name, number of surveyed ore blocks and distance. Toggle off to hide them.

sections.title: Refine · Active, Press
lines: Open Tensura's normal refining menu. Use its existing recipes: base inputs go in the three left slots; reagents go in the five middle slots.
Use the native Refine/Repeat buttons. Ingredients and output remain stored when the menu closes. Refine works with the passive off.

sections.title: Obtaining and cost
lines: Unique skill in the normal reincarnation pool. Eligible for Fettered Human's roll. No aura or magicule activation/upkeep cost. Damage type: None.

entries.title: Exponentiation
entries.summary: Unique · In-slot passive. Square supported beneficial values; movement is excluded.

sections.title: Use
lines: Learn Exponentiation and equip it in the current Tensura skill preset. No toggle, resource cost or cooldown. Owning it or putting it in an inactive preset does not activate it.

sections.title: Affected
lines: Final outgoing HP/SHP damage; HP/SHP healing; aura and magicule recovery; native positive resource gains; kill EP pool awards; learning and mastery gains; XP and block/mob drop stack quantities.

Beneficial attributes: health/energy capacities, attack damage and speed, mining and chant speed, armor, barriers, elemental boosts/resistances, chances, senses, reach and other supported non-movement attributes.

sections.title: Rules and limits
lines: Each output is squared once. Formula inputs are read normally while calculating damage, recovery, mining and point gains. Saved base stats are not repeatedly squared. Removing the skill restores normal capacities and clamps current reserves.

Values of 1 or less are retained so fractions are not weakened. Chances stop at their native maximum; drops stop at each item’s normal stack size; finite number limits apply. Chained’s locked magicule cap remains locked.

sections.title: Excluded
lines: All movement: running, flying, swimming, sneaking, jumping, dashes, teleports, knockback and body size. Attack speed, mining speed and chant speed ARE included.

No squaring of costs, cooldowns, incoming damage, progression requirements, recipe outputs, enchantment levels or fixed skill constants such as duration/radius. The web wiki lists exact native attribute IDs.
